scope: new synthetic planar MPC and fixed-axis wheel comparisons; no D1/B22 training or hardware claims
immutable_archive: Do not edit frozen sources or runtime/d1_b22/runtime_manifest_v27.json; do not run or reuse archived experiment48; fresh output directories only; no resume/overwrite

resource_contract.execution: root-owned serial systemd; CPU and one environment

mpc.hypothesis: doubling height-state weight can reduce combined-model-mismatch height tracking error without worsening tracking, effort or solve time
mpc.unique_variable: Q[2,2] 90 -> 180; dependent terminal Riccati weight recomputed by unchanged controller
mpc.fixed: all other Q entries, R, horizon20, constraints, nominal model, scenario initial state, command sequence, noise pairing and optimizer
mpc.scenario_caveat: mismatch_delay=mass1.25,damping1.35,2 control-step command delay(40ms),sensor_noise1,push-45N@4.2s for0.1s; env.step queues entire MPC+residual, including pure MPC zero-residual runs. Combined stress, no isolated delay claim. Nominal zero-noise trajectory is seed-independent and its repeated runs are not independent statistical evidence.
mpc.metric_timing: post-transition state compared with command that drove that transition, matching archived experiments.compute_metrics; all samples including startup
mpc.preflight_rule: all12 episodes complete; mismatch mean height RMSE ratio<=.90; per-scenario speed,pitch RMS,pitch peak,normalized effort,wheel force RMS,leg force RMS ratios<=1.05; candidate max episode solveP95<=20ms; no significance claim
mpc.full_rule: same gates on80 complete episodes and paired two-sided95% Student-t interval for mismatch height candidate-baseline difference entirely below0; seeds are independent noise realizations, not a hardware population
mpc.failure_rule: any missing, duplicate, failed or partial episode disqualifies the cohort; raw trajectories and failures retained

pi.hypothesis: reducing total identified feedforward by25% reduces stress saturation without material tracking regression
pi.fixed: saved fit parameters (no refit); PI kp.12,ki.6;2Nm limit;dt.002;truth(.017,.105,.043,delay2); noise scale1; paired noise stream; known physical inertia unchanged
pi.implementation: scale controller-only load inertia and continuous feedforward coefficients algebraically; do not change plant or original fit; existing compute retains conditional integration on the scaled torque
pi.inspection: read recorded stress CSV torque components; fixed-feedback counterfactual is directional only, not a closed-loop prediction
pi.preflight_rule: all12 pressure episodes complete; each object mean saturation reduction>=5percentage points; stress mean RMSE ratio<=1.05; no speed guard trigger
pi.full_rule: all36 episodes complete; each object stress mean saturation reduction>=5percentage points; every object/task mean RMSE ratio<=1.05; no speed guard trigger
pi.scope: seeds vary measurement noise only; two synthetic objects (matched and extra Stribeck friction.08Nm); fit mismatch delay4 is at search boundary and no inverse delay compensation is used
pi.failure_rule: reject without multiplier sweep; preserve all failures/partial runs
pi.failure_preservation: PI follows frozen evaluator sampling/noise/order exactly while flushing each completed transition to CSV; SIGTERM/SIGINT raise and save failure.json; source PI implementation and frozen evaluator are unchanged.

execution_order: inspect -> mpc preflight -> mpc full only if preflight passes -> pi preflight -> pi full only if preflight passes; no automatic rerun
admission: Full requires exact preregistration SHA, complete accepted preflight summary and verified artifact hashes. No training or saved-model invocation.
